source: Two-pass document-level translation (Claude Opus 5, in-session, not via API)
method: Pass 1 built a glossary and speaker model from the whole 10-minute window; pass 2 translated merged sentences with both backward and forward context, then remapped onto the original cue grid.
caveat: Produced in a Claude Code session rather than through a controlled API call, by a translator who had already catalogued the baseline's failure categories. Treat as indicative, not as a blind measurement. A human reference translation is still needed to score both fairly.

pass_1_glossary.speaker: 不知火フレア / Shiranui Flare, Hololive VTuber. Refers to herself in third person as フレちゃん (Flare-chan). Addresses the viewers/chat directly throughout.
pass_1_glossary.setting: Solo playthrough of a farming/life-sim game (ほの暮しの庭), interleaved with talking to chat about an upcoming ARK tournament.

terms.アーク: ARK - both the game and the Hololive tournament event

asr_errors_corrected_from_context.高感度イベント: → 好感度イベント (affection events). Homophone; the literal reading 'high-sensitivity event' is meaningless in a farming sim.
asr_errors_corrected_from_context.自立神経: → 自律神経 (autonomic nervous system). Homophone.

pass_1_glossary.register: Casual, chatty, heavy filler (なんか / あの / さ). Renders as relaxed conversational English; keep the hedging, drop most filler.
